prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel art sprite atlas for DevCorp office tycoon. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY showing the game's existing native furniture, NOT an edit target. Create a BRAND NEW transparent RGBA sprite sheet, square 1024x1024, EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows with equal 512x512 invisible cells. One isolated object centered horizontally in each cell, all objects' ground contact at y=440 within its cell, keep at least 60px transparent margin. No grid lines, labels, letters, numbers, borders, checkerboard background, walls, floor tiles, room scene, people, logos or watermark. Camera: fixed classic game 2:1 isometric 30 degree, top visible, front-left brighter and right face darker, pixel clusters and jagged crisp pixel contours, restrained hand-drawn late-90s management-game aesthetic. Match reference compact shapes and realistic small proportions. Use a logical 64x64-pixel sprite vocabulary upscaled with nearest-neighbor pixel blocks, limited warm walnut, parchment cream, muted teal, dark graphite, olive green palette; NO smooth gradients, NO glossy 3D, NO illustrated fuzzy painterly edges, NO tiny high-resolution ornament. All 4 objects must have equal native pixel size and consistent camera. Shape each object to fit one 64x32 ground footprint with height at most 80 native pixels. True transparent background including between objects. Atlas A / oficina e planejamento. Row-major exact subjects: TOP LEFT compact walnut electronics prototyping workbench with a small blue cutting mat, a soldering station and two little storage drawers, no computer monitor, NO chair. TOP RIGHT a compact freestanding acoustic focus booth, muted teal fabric sides and walnut frame, open doorway facing viewer and cream seat visible inside, no doorglass. BOTTOM LEFT rolling office supply trolley with two dark green trays, two small cardboard boxes and paper rolls, four small wheels. BOTTOM RIGHT freestanding wood-framed planning board on two small sturdy feet, cream board with just simple colored sticky squares, absolutely no writing. Distinct readable silhouettes, plausible construction, no generic neon tech shapes.
